source_caption:
🎬 Speechless (2016–2019)

Speechless follows the DiMeo family, a loving but chaotic household navigating the everyday challenges of parenting, school, relationships, and family life. At the center is Maya DiMeo, a fiercely protective and outspoken mother who will do almost anything to ensure her eldest son, JJ, a teenager with cerebral palsy who uses a communication board, receives the opportunities and respect he deserves. Alongside her easygoing husband Jimmy, Maya raises three very different children while frequently challenging schools, administrators, and anyone who underestimates her family. JJ is intelligent, funny, and determined to experience life on his own terms, while his younger siblings, Ray and Dylan, face their own struggles involving friendships, school, and growing up. When the family moves to a new neighborhood to find a more accessible school environment for JJ, they encounter unexpected challenges, hilarious misunderstandings, and unusual new friendships. With the help of Kenneth, JJ’s supportive aide, the family learns to balance independence, responsibility, and the importance of allowing everyone to make their own choices. From embarrassing school events and family arguments to heartfelt conversations, outrageous adventures, and emotional milestones, the DiMeos discover that their differences make their bond even stronger. Combining clever comedy, relatable family moments, and heartfelt storytelling, the series celebrates inclusion, individuality, friendship, acceptance, and unconditional love.

🎭 Genre: Sitcom • Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Scott Silveri

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Speechless is an American television sitcom that aired on ABC from September 21, 2016, to April 12, 2019. Created by Scott Silveri and co-executive produced with Christine Gernon, Jake Kasdan, and Melvin Mar, the 20th Century Fox Television/ABC Studios co-production was greenlighted to series order on May 13, 2016. A first-look trailer was released on the same day. Starring Minnie Driver, John Ross Bowie and Micah Fowler, the sitcom explores the serious and humorous challenges a family faces with a teenager with a disability.
